task: Oracle dialect: `JSON_TABLE` fails to parse when the input expression carries `FORMAT JSON` (e.g. `JSON_TABLE(doc FORMAT JSON, '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (...))`). Support `FORMAT JSON` there so it parses and round-trips.
why:
Scope and fidelity decided it. In the base repo the task's own example already parses and round-trips. c2 fixes a real Oracle gap next to it: `FORMAT JSON` on a COLUMNS entry (e.g. `doc2 CLOB FORMAT JSON PATH '$.x'`), which fails in the base. It does this with a one-line reuse of the existing `_parse_format_json`.
Runner-up c3 (c1 has the same code): it adds `ENCODING` to the shared `FormatJson` node, and as far as I know Oracle's `JSON_TABLE` doesn't accept that. The change also affects every `FORMAT JSON` user in every dialect, which the task didn't ask for.
